classes.name: City Rat
automation_gaps: Attribute-role thresholds are descriptive rather than enforced; the class has no general attribute requirement.
P.P.E. +1D10+4 and its age-22 halving, including age/base/rounding, are not automated.
Starting credits, Black Market item, equipment, body armor, and 1D4+2 cybernetic implants are not automated.
The minimum of three Physical or Rogue related skills is not enforced, including whether Hand to Hand upgrades count toward it.
The complete class skill catalog and prerequisites are not present; category permissions are represented only where the catalog supports them.

classes.name: Wilderness Scout
automation_gaps: Eligibility guidance: I.Q. 8 and P.E. 12 or higher; any alignment, no racial restriction. High P.S. and M.E. are helpful.
Cross-country travel, trail following, map errors and conditional activity effects use the source descriptions.
Only the available reviewed weapon and equipment catalog is selectable; broader catalog coverage remains in progress.
